cluster_name.description: Name of the Slony-I replication cluster — must be identical on all nodes.

log_dir.description: Directory where Slony-I daemon logs are stored.

database_name.description: Name of the Slony-I admin database (on the primary node).

primary_host.description: Hostname or IP of the primary (source) PostgreSQL server.

primary_port.description: PostgreSQL port on the primary node.

slony_user.description: Database user with replication privileges (must exist and have superuser rights on the primary).

poll_interval.description: Seconds between health checks and replication heartbeat polling.

retry_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed connection to a node.

retry_count.description: Number of connection retries before marking a node as failed.

pidfile_path.description: Path to the Slony-I daemon PID file.

nodes.description: List of PostgreSQL nodes in the Slony-I cluster (primary and replicas).

name.description: Internal identifier for the node (used in config references).

host.description: Hostname or IP of the PostgreSQL server.

password.description: Password for the replication user (may be omitted if using .pgpass or trust).

dbname.description: Database where Slony-I metadata is stored (typically 'slony1').

paths.description: List of replication paths (source node → target node) between nodes.

forwarder.description: Optional intermediate node ID for multi-hop replication (null = direct path).

sequences.description: Optional list of PostgreSQL sequences to be managed by Slony-I.

schema.description: Database schema where the sequence resides.

owner.description: Owner of the sequence in PostgreSQL.

tables.description: Optional list of PostgreSQL tables to be replicated.

schema.description: Database schema where the table resides.

owner.description: Owner of the table in PostgreSQL.

pk_column.description: Name of the primary key column.

pk_sequence.description: Name of the sequence used to generate PK values (if any).

columns.description: List of column names to replicate (if empty or null, all columns are replicated).

retention_interval.description: Retention period (in seconds) for Slony-I event logs (default: 86400 = 1 day).
